gcp.compute.custom_spot.memory.note: Spot custom machine type memory rate per family. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.custom_spot.vcpu.note: Spot custom machine type vcpu rate per family. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.disk.note: Persistent Disk and Hyperdisk provisioned capacity by disk type (GiB-month); regional-* rows are regional (synchronously replicated) Persistent Disk. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.disk_iops.note: Provisioned IOPS of Extreme Persistent Disk and Hyperdisk by disk type. Hyperdisk Balanced includes 3,000 IOPS and Hyperdisk Balanced High Availability 3,000; the rest are billed. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.disk_throughput.note: Provisioned throughput of Hyperdisk by disk type (per MiB/s a month). Hyperdisk Balanced includes 140 MiB/s and Hyperdisk Balanced High Availability 140; the rest are billed. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.gpu.note: On-demand price of one GPU attached to an N1 VM (guest_accelerator); -vws rows add the NVIDIA RTX Virtual Workstation license. Accelerator-optimized machine types include their GPUs. null where the GPU is not offered in the region. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.gpu_spot.note: Spot price of one GPU attached to an N1 Spot VM; null where the page lists none. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.ip.spot_vm.note: External IPv4 address in use on a Spot or preemptible VM. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

filters.description: ^External IP Charge on a Spot Preemptible VM

gcp.compute.ip.standard_vm.note: Static or ephemeral external IPv4 address in use on a standard VM or by Cloud NAT; the one free hour a month is ignored. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

filters.description: ^External IP Charge on a Standard VM

gcp.compute.ip.unused.note: Static external IPv4 address reserved but not assigned to a resource. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.local_ssd.note: Local SSD provisioned space (GiB-month, 375 GiB per device) on general-purpose VMs. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.local_ssd_spot.note: Local SSD provisioned space attached to Spot VMs (GiB-month). Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

filters.description: ^SSD backed Local Storage attached to Spot Preemptible VMs

gcp.compute.machine.note: On-demand price of each predefined machine type (vCPUs and memory together; accelerator-optimized G2 and G4 types include their GPUs) from the general-purpose, compute-optimized, memory-optimized, storage-optimized, network-optimized and accelerator-optimized pages. Linux images; premium OS licenses are extra. The Billing Catalog prices a family's cores and memory, not a machine type, so the table has no sync spec. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.

gcp.compute.machine_spot.note: Spot VM price of each predefined machine type. Spot prices change up to once a month; null where the page lists no spot price. The E2 shared-core types (e2-micro, e2-small, e2-medium) have no Spot table: they bill a fraction of the E2 Spot core and memory SKUs, 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2 of e2-standard-2 as on demand. Read from the pricing page's regional tables; sync verifies rows with a single Billing Catalog SKU once credentials are set.
